in_greek.name: Ελισάβετ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η επιβώλη μου

data.cultural_impact: Isabeau holds an enchanting appeal in Christian history, as it was the name of two notable figures. The first is Isabeau of Bavaria, a queen consort of France in the late 13th and early 14th centuries. She was known for her exquisite beauty and charm, and her influence on the French court during the reign of King Philip IV. The second is Isabella of Spain, a queen consort of England in the late 15th and early 16th centuries. She was a key player in the wars of the Roses, and her marriage to King Henry VII marked the end of the Wars and the beginning of the Tudor Dynasty.
data.spiritual_significance: Isabeau carries the reminder that God is an oath or a promise, a constant presence and support in our lives. This name underscores the significance of maintaining firm commitments to our beliefs and values, and to the promises we make to our loved ones and to our faith. As Isabeau, one strives to embody the virtues of loyalty, strength, and devotion to seemlessly merge spiritual and worldly aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Isabeau of Bavaria (1271-1348) was a German duchess, the eldest daughter of Otto II, Duke of Bavaria. She was a pious and learned woman, who founded the Poor Clares monastery in Munich in 1313.
historical_references.context: German nobility, foundation of a monastery

historical_references.reference: Isabeau of France (1348-1435), also known as Isabella of Valois, was the queen consort of King Charles VI of France. She was renowned for her beauty and extravagant lifestyle, and was accused of sorcery and madness.

modern_usage.modern_context: Isabeau is a name of French origin, meaning 'given by God'. In modern contexts, it is commonly associated with French royalty, beauty and cosmetics, and art and design. On Instagram, accounts like @isabeau_royalty showcase beautiful images of French castles and royalty, while on Pinterest, boards dedicated to Isabeau often feature images of French beauty and cosmetics. On DeviantArt, artists often create digital paintings and drawings inspired by the name Isabeau, showcasing its artistic and regal qualities.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Isabeau from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Isabeau - "God is my oath". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Isabeau: God is my oath or God is my pledge. This name signifies one who entrusts her life and faith entirely to the divine providence of God.
